personalInfo.name: Enes
personalInfo.location: İstanbul, Turkey — open to remote / relocation

about.summary: Senior Software Engineer and Software Architect with 15+ years designing distributed, cloud-native, event-driven platforms and high-throughput microservices on the JVM. Full-lifecycle engineer who carries features from OpenAPI contract through Java / Spring Boot services and Kafka / SQS event flows to Kubernetes / GitOps deployment, observability, security, and a production React / TypeScript frontend. Proven at scale — architected microservices platforms targeting 100K TPS — and in the high-integrity work of platform modernization and large-scale data migration. Technical leader and Scrum Master who has led and mentored teams of up to 10. For the past ~2 years, has practiced agentic development (AI-assisted engineering) across architecture design, implementation, debugging, code review, test generation, and documentation, primarily via AI coding agents and the Claude API.

cloudDevops: AWS (Glue, RDS, S3, EC2, Lambda, Cognito, IAM, Route 53, SNS)
aiAssisted: Agentic development with AI coding agents (incl. Claude API)
Architecture, implementation, debugging, code review, test generation & documentation

experiences.title: Senior Software Engineering Consultant
responsibilities: Owned features end to end across the stack — OpenAPI contracts, Java / Spring Boot 3.x services, Kafka (Confluent + Avro) and AWS SQS/SNS event flows, Kubernetes / ArgoCD GitOps deployment, and a React / TypeScript frontend.
Built cloud-native microservices on a hexagonal architecture with PostgreSQL, event-driven domain events, and the transactional outbox pattern.
Hardened legacy-to-modern data-migration pipelines (Scala, config-driven ETL) by resolving idempotency, file-verification, special-character, null-safety, and audit edge cases.
Implemented tenant-aware features: record-level capture, row-level-security (RLS) authorization filtering, read-model synchronization, and service-to-service permission checks.

Delivered platform-level reliability wins — resolved a PostgreSQL connection-pool exhaustion issue and designed per-tenant queue fairness for multi-tenant workloads — with OpenTelemetry / Grafana observability, TestContainers / E2E tests, and security hardening (Snyk, gitleaks).
Applied agentic development across the lifecycle, using AI coding agents (including the Claude API) for design, implementation, debugging, code review, and test generation.

experiences.title: Software Development Team Lead
responsibilities: Led a cross-functional team of 10 (developers, analysts, QA/testers) delivering high-availability web services with Java / Spring Boot, Vue.js, RabbitMQ, Redis, PostgreSQL, and AWS (S3, Lambda, Cognito).
Decomposed a monolith into five independently deployable services, improving deployability and team autonomy.
Stood up CI/CD across seven applications (Docker, DigitalOcean, AWS, GitLab CI), reducing release friction.
Raised engineering quality through code review, pair programming, and knowledge-sharing sessions; hired, coached, and mentored junior engineers.

experiences.title: Software Architect
responsibilities: Promoted from Senior Developer to Architect to own the technical direction and architectural standards for I2I's clustered, event-driven microservices platform — the same system I had helped design and build.

Owned end-to-end architecture of the Kafka-based microservices estate, defining patterns for service decomposition, clustering, concurrency, and fault tolerance to sustain high-availability, high-throughput workloads.
Led design and architecture reviews across the engineering team and drove proof-of-concept evaluations to de-risk and guide new technology adoption.
Mentored senior and mid-level engineers on distributed-systems and microservices design, raising the team's architectural maturity.

experiences.title: Senior Software Analysis Developer
responsibilities: Architected and built three clustered, highly available, multi-threaded applications spanning 28 microservices (Java, Kafka, Akka, VoltDB, Oracle, Hazelcast, Elasticsearch).
Designed a Kafka-based microservices architecture achieving 100K TPS with low-latency, non-intrusive processing.
Introduced CI/CD, enabling fail-safe deployments and shifting the team's delivery culture.
Built KPI / observability dashboards (Grafana, Kibana, Elasticsearch) and an Angular + Spring Boot client-server application; developed a Node.js + Vue.js dashboard.

Led change management and served as Scrum Master for a team of nine; delivered 41 sprints and 1,000+ resolved issues.
